text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There is still time before training...
Let's take a moment to review the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, there's a short quiz
in math class on this day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"If that happens, I won't have enough study time the day before.
Let's extend it by 30 minutes here..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
For extending it by 30 minutes,
I'll have to cut down on self-training time this evening...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, we should be able to secure time for voluntary training
if we add more sessions on other days. As for the previous week's schedule...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: At this rate, we might as well rebuild the schedule completely from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Without a perfect schedule,
there can be no perfect training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Eishin Flash ended up forgetting about her training.
